checks[14]=re.findall(r'"'^## (.*)$'"',s,re.M)==heads and not any(t in s for t in ['<"'!--'"','ARCH-000','PRD-000','YYYY-MM-DD','<component>']) and '"'```mermaid'"\\nflowchart' in s
